title: stapes: an open benchmark of on-device and cloud speech recognition for clinical conversations
description: Evaluation code, model inference scripts, ROVER fusion implementation, exhaustive pair and triple round-robin search, and the fusion depth-study supporting the manuscript "Medication Names Are a Safety-Critical Failure Mode in Clinical Speech Recognition: An Open Benchmark of On-Device and Cloud Systems". Benchmarks 12 on-device ASR models and 5 cloud APIs on 400 clinical conversations from three public datasets.

creators.name: Faulkenberry, J. Grey
